## Recent

### Headlights in the mirror

Same height, same distance, three nights running. They turn when I turn, and they never pass.

### Coughing behind me in line

Not once in a while. Every time, in every store, and always just as I reach the front.

### Same man, three stores

Gray hoodie, no basket, at the end of the aisle each time. I took a picture from the register.

### Everyone in red at the pharmacy

Four of them in line, all in red, and none of them buying anything.

### I started a log

A column for could be nothing, so I can tell my notes from my nerves, and keep honest books.
